parcel_tessa.name: Parcel for Tessa
parcel_tessa.desc: A small box addressed to Tessa Reed, Skywatch Point. Heavier than it looks.

parcel_tavern.name: Parcel for the Windsong Tavern
parcel_tavern.desc: A crate of spice tins for the Windsong Tavern's kitchen.

parcel_cliffs.name: Parcel for the Cloud Edge
parcel_cliffs.desc: Seed packets for the flower terraces near the Cloud Edge.

deed.name: Deed to the Workshop
deed.desc: The deed to Elias Thorn's workshop on Old Cartographer's Bluff, now in Kieran's name.

elias_journal.name: Elias's Final Journal
elias_journal.desc: 'The maps are wrong. They always have been. If you're reading this, look where the wind refuses to go.'

brass_compass.name: Brass Compass
brass_compass.desc: Inherited from Elias. Since the night in the workshop its needle points along a wind current that isn't on any map.

ancient_glider.name: Ancient Glider
ancient_glider.desc: Found beneath the workshop floor. Brass components unlike any modern technology. Hold Glide in the air to use it.

courier_wages.name: Courier Wages
courier_wages.desc: A morning's pay from the Post House. Maren counted it twice.
